saetze.title: Practice set 1
saetze.sourcing: The shape (four skills; long-text comprehension, gap tasks, matching, extended writing and speaking) is modelled on what is generally known about the DAPLE C1; the real paper structure, timings, numbers of items and the language-use component are 'to verify' on caple.letras.ulisboa.pt. All texts, questions and listening scripts here were written by icanspeak Portuguese; nothing is copied or closely paraphrased from a CAPLE paper or sample paper. CAPLE is a centre of the University of Lisbon and has no connection with this site. There are no recordings yet, so you read the listening scripts.

scoring.note: The real DAPLE is awarded on a pass or fail basis. The pass mark and any minimum per paper: to verify on the CAPLE site. The 60 % line is our own guide for this practice set, not an official pass mark.
